The action lemma shows that exactly the square classes fix τ, giving the index-two subgroup. The published uniqueness theorem then identifies the field. Since τ²=p*, choice of the primitive root changes only τ by a Legendre sign, never its square or field. Sources inspected: Jerry Shurman, Math 361 Ninth Lecture, §§2–3; J. S.
